definition.description: Whether the patient has a documented family history of colon cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient's record, specifically within the Family History section, indicates a relative had colon cancer.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if family history is not mentioned or is explicitly documented as unknown.
definition.name: family_history_of_colon_cancer

definition.description: Presence of lung cancer in the patient's family history.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's medical record indicates a family history of lung cancer. A value of 'Yes' is assigned if any relative (e.g., father, mother, sibling) is documented as having had lung cancer. A value of 'No' is assigned if the record explicitly states there is no family history of lung cancer.
definition.missing_value_rule: If family history is not mentioned, is not specifically addressed regarding lung cancer, or is documented as unknown, the value is represented as null.
definition.name: family_history_of_lung_cancer

definition.description: Presence of a family history of myocardial infarction
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether there is a documented history of myocardial infarction (MI) or heart attack in first-degree relatives (parents, siblings, or children) within the patient's family history records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if family history is not documented or explicitly stated as unknown.
definition.name: family_history_of_myocardial_infarction

definition.description: The severity of patient-reported fatigue, typically measured on a grade scale.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the severity grade of fatigue using the 0-4 scale (e.g., CTCAE or PRO-CTCAE). Map descriptive terms as follows: 'none' to 0, 'mild' to 1, 'moderate' to 2, 'severe' to 3, and 'life-threatening' or 'disabling' to 4. If only a continuous score from a different instrument is provided (e.g., 0-100 or 0-10) without an explicit grade, treat as null to avoid ad hoc formula invention.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if fatigue is not mentioned or if the reported value cannot be reliably mapped to the 0-4 ordinal scale.
definition.name: fatigue

definition.description: Presence of chemotherapy-induced febrile neutropenia in the patient's medical history.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented occurrence of febrile neutropenia, typically identified by explicit mention of the diagnosis, hospital admissions for febrile neutropenia, or treatment-related toxicity notes mentioning fever during neutropenia.
definition.missing_value_rule: If febrile neutropenia is not documented or explicitly denied, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: febrile_neutropenia_presence

definition.description: Presence or absence of FGFR1 gene amplification in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of FGFR1 gene amplification from molecular profiling, Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), or FISH reports. 'Amplification', 'Amplified', or a high copy number (e.g., >6) indicates the 'Amplified' status. 'No amplification detected' or 'Not amplified' indicates the 'Not Amplified' status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if FGFR1 amplification status is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: fgfr1_amplification_status

definition.description: Presence of a focal lesion located within the brain parenchyma.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify from the radiology report whether focal intra-axial lesions are identified or noted as absent.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention focal intra-axial lesions or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: focal_intra_axial_lesion

definition.description: Whether gadolinium-based contrast agent was administered during the imaging procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Search the pretreatment record for explicit mention of gadolinium administration or descriptors indicating a contrast-enhanced study using gadolinium.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if contrast use is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the provided text.
definition.name: gadolinium_contrast_use

definition.description: Patient's ability to tolerate treatment with gemcitabine.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient tolerated gemcitabine (Gemzar) from clinical notes, looking for explicit statements of tolerance or intolerance.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding gemcitabine tolerance is documented.
definition.name: gemcitabine_tolerance

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the value associated with 'Gender Identity' from the patient's medical records, such as the demographic section or NGS report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If gender identity is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: gender_identity

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
